subject: PayNest SOC 2 follow-up: management response, evidence, and bridge letter
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@paynest.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PayNest Audit Team <audit@paynest.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II findings follow-up & bridge letter

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Our audit team completed their SOC 2 Type II review of integrations in Q4 2026 and surfaced a small set of findings that need either a management response or evidence of remediation to close. I wanted to follow up with the list we discussed and confirm timelines:

- Finding #3 (User access review not completed for one service account during Oct 2026)
- Finding #7 (Third-party vendor security questionnaire outstanding for vendor X)
- Finding #9 (Interim logging retention gap for a four-week window in Nov 2026)

Could you provide: 1) a formal management response for each finding, 2) any supporting artifacts (review logs, vendor SIG response, config screenshots), and 3) whether Redwood can provide a short bridge letter covering the period 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31 clarifying compensating controls in place while remediation was completed?

We aim to close the audit package by Apr 22 — can you confirm if a draft management response and evidence bundle is possible by Apr 14?

Appreciate it,

Alex Morgan
Director, Security
PayNest

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@paynest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II findings follow-up & bridge letter

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list and target date. We appreciate the heads-up; below is our management response summary and a proposed delivery plan. We will attach a remediation action matrix and draft bridge letter for your review.

Management responses (summary):
- Finding #3 (service account access review): We acknowledge the lapse. Access review is a quarterly automated workflow; an exception occurred due to a permissions filter change in Oct 2026 which excluded a service account from the reviewer list. Remediation completed 2026-11-03: the missing account was added, a retrospective review completed, and a new alert added to prevent filter drift.
- Finding #7 (vendor X questionnaire): Vendor X completed their SIG-Lite on 2027-01-15. We have attached the vendor response PDF and the procurement acceptance log.
- Finding #9 (logging retention gap): A short-term retention policy mismatch caused logs for one ingestion stream to drop below the 90-day retention for four weeks in Nov 2026. We implemented a retention reconciliation job on 2026-12-01 and re-ingested missing logs where available.

Proposed deliverables and dates:
- Apr 14, 2027: Draft management responses + remediation_action_matrix_paynest.xlsx (includes control owners, completion dates, evidence pointers).
- Apr 14, 2027: Draft bridge_letter_apr2027.pdf (covering 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31; notes on compensating controls and timelines).
- Apr 16, 2027: Evidence bundle link (Drive) containing audit logs, screenshots, vendor SIG, and the SOC2 PDF.

Attachments included now: remediation_action_matrix_paynest.xlsx (matrix with owners and evidence pointers). We will push the full evidence bundle to the Drive link in my signature and send the SOC 2 Type II PDF once legal clears distribution (should be by Apr 16).

If that schedule works, Laura will coordinate the bridge letter finalization and Marcus will pull the specific access-review logs. If you have a short-format template PayNest prefers for bridge letters, please share and we'll align.

Thanks —

Irene
Irene Choi
Head, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDq-example-evidence

[Attachment: remediation_action_matrix_paynest.xlsx]

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@paynest.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PayNest Audit Team <audit@paynest.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PayNest SOC 2 follow-up: management response, evidence, and bridge letter

Irene —

Thanks, that timeline is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from the audit team to make sure we can close the items:

1) For Finding #3: can you include the historical access-review export that shows the service account exclusion and the subsequent remediation sign-off (owner + timestamp)? The audit team wants to see the before/after.
2) For Finding #9: please attach the output of the retention reconciliation job (logs) and the list of re-ingested files (or a statement that re-ingestion was not possible with reason).
3) SOC2 Type II PDF: we will need a copy for our audit package. If there are distribution controls (legal/NDAs), we can accept a redacted copy or DocuSign-controlled distribution.

If you can get the draft bridge letter to us now for internal review, we can save review cycles. Otherwise Apr 14 works for the full set.

Alex
